status.name: status
status.help: Set the trust status of the public key.

type.help: Set the type of the public key.

options.help: The type of the public key is RSA.

options.help: The type of the public key is DSA.

options.help: The type of the public key is ECDSA.

options.name: ED25519
options.help: The type of the public key is ED25519.

options.name: RSA-CA
options.help: The type of the public key is from RSA CA.

options.name: DSA-CA
options.help: The type of the public key is from DSA CA.

options.name: ECDSA-CA
options.help: The type of the public key is from ECDSA CA.

options.name: ED25519-CA
options.help: The type of the public key is from ED25519 CA.

nid.name: nid
nid.help: Set the nid of the ECDSA key.

options.help: Transparent proxy uses this public key to validate server.

options.name: access-proxy
options.help: Access proxy uses this public key to validate server.

ip.name: ip
ip.help: IP address of the SSH server.

hostname.name: hostname
hostname.help: Hostname of the SSH server to match SSH certificate principals.
